title: Integral closure in a field is the intersection of valuation overrings
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $R\subseteq F$ a subring. Let $B=\{y\in F:y\text{ satisfies a monic polynomial over }R\}$ be the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Then $B=\bigcap_{R\subseteq T\subseteq F,\ T\text{ a valuation subring of }F}T$, where valuation subring means that for every $z\in F^\times$, either $z\in T$ or $z^{-1}\in T$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. Equivalently, $y\in F$ is integral over $R$ if and only if it belongs to every valuation subring of $F$ containing $R$.
